name: aux-guild
cmd: set -e; X=/mnt/e/Datasets/houfin/external; {python} -I research/exp/aux_covariates.py --grid ${HOUFIN_DATA}/ref_grid_27km.tif --out {out}/aux_27km.npz --forest-age $X/forest_age_pan/extracted/Data/2011/ca_us_age11_250m.img --forest-ref-year 2011 --crp-csv $X/crp_county/csv/HISTORICAL.csv --counties $X/census_counties/shp/cb_2018_us_county_500k.shp --y0 1940 --y1 2025; C=$(ls -d {outroot}/E047/cropat-types-*/ | head -1)cropat_27km.npz; D=${HOUFIN_DATA}/avonet; for k in forest crp; do for c in desk_tempho_1995_s1 desk_tempho_1985_s1; do {python} research/exp/guild_dose.py --cache {cache}/$c --cropat $C --avonet $D/TraitData/AVONET1_BirdLife.csv --taxonomy $D/eBird_taxonomy.csv --out {out}/$c --pooled --rival-all --aux {out}/aux_27km.npz --aux-key $k; done; done
summarize: grep -F '[aux]' {out}/log.txt; for c in desk_tempho_1995_s1 desk_tempho_1985_s1; do {python} research/exp/guild_dose.py --summarize {out}/$c | grep -E 'tested|type|Grassland|Forest|Woodland|grassland gain'; done
note: E050: forest-age/succession (Pan 2011 stand age, back-cast) and CRP (FSA county 1986-2008) on the 27 km grid; guild-pooled gain beyond ALL covariate change, moved nulls
